definitions.d2: mech_analysis D2 at the end snapshot (seeds with D2 in both arms); B: debiased RMS with the reflected CI
definitions.matched_excess: d2_paired(FR class c, ABF all, matched=True): B_excess = B_c|J - B_ABF|c
definitions.mc3: B_excess_did = young-clone matched excess at lambda_hi minus at lambda 1; Holm over N; passes iff Holm p < 0.05 and estimate < 0
definitions.genealogy: ess_win_tavg = mean gen_ess_win over the 200 uniform-u saves with step >= genealogy window; maxfam_win_max = max gen_maxfam_win over all saves
definitions.cost: (a) sum full / successes; (b) (sum_success tau cost + sum_failure full) / successes; walker-steps exact (numerators integer), core-seconds from wall_s
definitions.abf_ratio: ratio of inf-aware seed medians lambda / lambda 1, paired bootstrap, censoring conventions
